talk_wizard_1:
Aloha e keiki kāne!
He aha kāu e hana nei ma lalo nei?
talk_player_1:
Aloha!
Ua hoʻouna ʻia au e kākoʻo i keiki i kāū a i nā mea e noho ana i nā kūlanakauhale ma lalo nei.
talk_wizard_2:
Ae...
ʻAʻole au makemake e hoʻopilikino, akā ʻo ʻoe ke kanalima e kākoʻo ʻia i kēia hana. A i hiki mai, ʻaʻohe mea i huki, a me nā kino i huki ʻia ma nā pā i like me nā hanohano.
talk_player_2:
Mai luhi, e kūpuna. ʻAʻole i hiki ke like me au!
E kāohi au i nā mea a pau ma lalo nei a huki i keiki!

ʻAe, ʻaʻole e ʻōlelo ʻia ua hoʻomaopopo ʻole au!
Hōʻailona!
